description: Write the app-ads.txt file served at https://{subdomain}.apppage.net/app-ads.txt, which ad networks (AdMob and others) check against the developer website in the store listing. One record per line: ad system domain, publisher account id, DIRECT or RESELLER, optional certification id, e.g. "google.com, pub-1234567890123456, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0". The lines are checked first; nothing is saved if any has an error. mode=append adds only the records that aren't there yet.

mode.description: replace (default) the whole file, or append the new records.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: set_app_ads_txt
title: Set a site's app-ads.txt
